$description: Tier 3: the Spinner. Emitted without the `component` prefix: --spinner-duration.

duration.$description: Ours: one full turn of the Spinner arc. Slower than the motion scale on purpose: a wait indicator should feel calm, not urgent. It is NOT a motion.duration token, so it does not collapse under reduced motion (a wait indicator that stops looks like a frozen page); components.css slows it instead.
